# Owned diagnostic repository: delivery

Public API: candidate_app.handle({operation, payload}). Inputs must remain unchanged.

- parcels: Split a nonnegative integer item count into full capacity parcels then one remainder; omit zero-size parcels.
- zones: Choose the longest matching postal prefix; return its zone or null when no prefix matches.
- billable: Billable kilograms are ceiling(max(actual grams, dimensional grams)/1000), with zero weight billed zero.
- events: Return unique tracking event IDs in first-seen order.
- charge: Compute decimal base plus per-kg rate times weight, rounding half up to exactly two decimal places as text.

Run public checks with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
